title: Public Pedal Pub Tour in Austin
includes: A driver to facilitate your tour
requirements: Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Canned drinks only for BYOB. No hard liquor or glass containers.
We do have a back bench that does not require pedaling for those unable to pedal.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
*Please arrive 30 minutes early for check-in*

We are a great BYOB tour for birthdays, bachelor/bachelorette parties, corporate events, weddings, reunions and date nights. Pedal-powered by you and your friends! Each bike has 10 pedal seats and 5 non-pedal seats. Your awesome driver will bring the energy while keeping you safe. Our bikes are equipped with a sound system so you can play your own music! All tours are BYOB - we provide a cooler with ice. During your 2-hour tour you will enjoy the drinks you brought onto the bike while singing out loud to your favorite tunes! We'll make stops at a few bars along the way where you can purchase drinks to enjoy while there. We can also make stops at murals for pictures. Please note that our drivers are not trained to provide historical information. This is a fun pub crawl tour in scenic downtown.
